name: Svelte Dot Matrix Loaders
summary: 50+ free, open-source dot-matrix loaders for Svelte: animated squares, hexes, triangles and circles on a dot grid.
description: Animated dot-matrix loading indicators for Svelte, built with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS: square, hexagon, triangle and circle families, each rendered on a dot grid with props for size, dot size, speed and pattern, plus glow, opacity and reduced-motion options. Loaders install from the @sv/loaders registry via jsrepo or the shadcn-svelte CLI and share one dot-matrix runtime, hooks and stylesheet.
contains: shared dot-matrix runtime, hooks and stylesheet installed with each loader
props: size, dotSize, speed, pattern (diamond, full, outline, rose, cross, rings)
use cases: chat, AI chat, API fetching, form submission, file upload, server actions
install via jsrepo @sv/loaders or shadcn-svelte registry
